thread:
navin.patel: EDR reported a suspicious dylib write on dev-macbook-12 (user: @sam.k). Dropped to /usr/local/lib by a child of chrome.
edr-bot: Alert ID 0x7f9a3c, YARA match: mac_mal_dylib_v2, md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
carol.h: Ok, please isolate device and quarantine the file. Tag infra and SRE if network connections observed. :eyes:
sam.k: Acknowledged. I'm at my desk, can do a remote MDM isolate. Will also snapshot the process list first.
sam.k: Running:
```
mdmctl isolate-device --id dev-macbook-12 --reason "EDR dylib write" && edrctl quarantine --path "/usr/local/lib/suspicious.dylib"
```
edr-bot: Quarantine action queued by sam.k. Isolate job started (job 8721). Process tree attached: chrome -> child_pid 4528 -> spawned curl -> dropped file.
anya: Any signs of keychain access or ssh-agent interaction? Need to know scope before notifying infra/ops.
navin.patel: No immediate keychain alerts. EDR shows file created with uid=501, mode 755. I killed pid 4528 and removed network sockets.
sam.k: Isolate complete. Device in restricted network mode. Quarantine returned: success. File hash confirmed: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e. No other files matching pattern.
sec-bot: Running full client scan (YARA + AV) now. ETA ~8m. Preliminary telemetry: 3 DNS lookups to suspicious domain first seen 2h ago, no outbound uploads detected.
carol.h: Good. Next steps: 1) full disk scan, 2) pull fsnapshot and EDR artifacts, 3) scan other devices for same hash and parent process behavior, 4) user ticket + PO/Legal notification if data access suspected.
navin.patel: Collected artifacts: /var/log/edr/alerts/0x7f9a3c.log, process dump, launchd events. Uploading to sec-s3 (bucket: sec-artifacts) with restricted ACL.
sam.k: User will be reprovisioned if any persistence found. I'll coordinate with IT to rotate local certs and ask user to change any cached creds. Putting a hold on their session tokens.
anya: Please add the timeline and any outbound domains to the incident ticket. I'll draft comms to affected teams if scan finds lateral indicators.
sec-bot: Full scan complete: 1 match quarantined, no persistence artifacts (no launchagents, no cron entries). No other hosts with matching hash in last 72h. Closing investigative thread in 24h unless new indicators.
carol.h: Great work. Leave device isolated until IT confirms reprovision. Add follow-up scan in 48h. Marking as high-severity but contained. :white_check_mark:
navin.patel: Noted. I'll schedule the 48h follow-up and attach the artifact manifest. Thanks everyone.
